author: ETA PRIME
description:
I recently built this incredibly small 4.6L form factor all-AMD Mini PC to go head-to-head with the Steam Machine, and the performance is absolutely insane! Running on SteamOS 3.10, this custom SFF build packs a desktop Ryzen 7 7700X, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and the highly anticipated low-profile AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT with 16GB of VRAM.

LZMOD A24 Mini ITX PC Case: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3DmeCwt
AMD Ryzen 7700X: https://amzn.to/4yi5FF0
Thermalright APX 120 X67 Cooler: https://amzn.to/4yj1KI6
Apevia Modular ITX 500W: https://amzn.to/3Uwsere
ROG Strix B850i Mini ITX: https://amzn.to/3F8lOXm
32GB Viper Ram: https://amzn.to/4qVcOIX
vastarmor low profile rx 9060 XT: Coming Soon

We are testing Native 1080p, 1440p, and 4K performance benchmarks across Cyberpunk 2077, Shadow of the Tomb Raider, and Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered to see how much of a performance uplift we get over the standard Steam Machine. Plus, we check out real-world gameplay and dive into SteamOS desktop mode for app
title: This Tiny 4.6L SteamOS PC Is 2x Faster Than the Steam Machine!
